verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is a self-hosted AI platform with its own API, so shipping an official MCP server for external agents is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows Open WebUI acting as an MCP client, calling tools from external MCP servers. That client-side support does not count toward this server-side story. The gateway exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, not an MCP server, and no first-party MCP server or 'mcp serve' mode is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
